title: OpenClaw Email Newsletter Agent: Automate Your Newsletter From Research to Send
summary: Build an OpenClaw agent that researches topics, writes your newsletter, and sends it automatically on a schedule — without touching it yourself.
body_markdown: SOUL.md is the mechanism. Write it in first person, use specific examples of your phrasing, pull actual sentences from past issues as reference, and explicitly name words and constructions you never use. The more concrete the SOUL.md, the better the voice match. Run the agent 2-3 times, note where it sounds generic, update SOUL.md — it converges quickly. Vague instructions like "write conversationally" don't help; specific rules like "each story gets one sentence of context, then one sentence of my take" do.
